title.en: Spot the form, spot the meaning

es: Reconocer cómo cambia el significado entre must have y should have, wish y hope, used to y would, y entre dos condicionales muy parecidos.

teaching.en: The lights are off, so they must have left.
teaching.es: Las luces están apagadas, así que deben de haberse ido.
teaching.explanationEs: Must have + participio deduce algo pasado: no lo viste, pero estás casi seguro.
segments: The lights are off, so
they must have left.
teaching.audioText: The lights are off, so they must have left.

teaching.en: They should have left earlier, but they stayed to chat.
teaching.es: Deberían haberse ido antes, pero se quedaron charlando.
teaching.explanationEs: Should have + participio critica lo que no se hizo: aquí ocurrió lo contrario de lo correcto.
segments: They should have left earlier,
but they stayed to chat.
teaching.audioText: They should have left earlier, but they stayed to chat.

teaching.en: I wish I had a bigger flat, but I hope to find one soon.
teaching.es: Ojalá tuviera un piso más grande, pero espero encontrar uno pronto.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + pasado simple es un deseo irreal de hoy. Hope + infinitivo o presente es un deseo posible.
segments: I wish I had a bigger flat,
but I hope to find one soon.
teaching.audioText: I wish I had a bigger flat, but I hope to find one soon.

teaching.en: We used to swim in the lake, and we would race every Sunday.
teaching.es: Antes nadábamos en el lago y hacíamos carreras cada domingo.
teaching.explanationEs: Used to sirve para estados y hábitos pasados; would solo para hábitos repetidos.
segments: We used to swim in the lake,
and we would race every Sunday.
teaching.audioText: We used to swim in the lake, and we would race every Sunday.

teaching.en: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
teaching.es: Si nos hubiéramos ido antes, habríamos alcanzado el tren.
teaching.explanationEs: If + pasado perfecto y would have + participio hablan del pasado irreal; con if + pasado simple hablarías de hoy.
segments: If we had left earlier, we
would have caught the train.
teaching.audioText: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo dices que seguro se le agotó la batería a Mia?

choices.text: Her battery should have died.
Her battery must have died.
Her battery would have died.

feedback.es: Es una deducción sobre el pasado: must have + participio expresa casi seguridad sin haber visto el hecho.

hint.es: No lo viste, lo deduces con seguridad: busca must have.

origin.text: El móvil de Mia no responde. Estás casi seguro de que se quedó sin batería.

prompt.es: Completa: «Deberías haber llamado antes de venir.»

answer.text: should
accepted: should

feedback.es: Para criticar lo que no se hizo se usa should have + participio.

hint.es: Es un reproche por algo que no hiciste: elige el modal de consejo.

origin.text: You ___ have called before you came.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Ojalá tuviera un coche nuevo.»

answer.text: I wish I had a new car

feedback.es: Wish + pasado simple expresa un deseo irreal sobre el presente.

hint.es: Empieza con I wish y sigue con el pasado simple.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con el mensaje que transmite.

pairs: She must have forgotten her keys.
He should have trained more.
I wish I lived by the sea.
I hope to live by the sea.
They would sing on the bus every morning.

feedback.es: La forma decide el mensaje: must have deduce, should have critica, wish es irreal, hope es posible y would describe un hábito pasado.

pairs: She must have forgotten her keys.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo cuentas una costumbre que ya no tienes?

choices.text: I must have gone to the lake every summer.
I should go to the lake every summer.
I used to go to the lake every summer.

feedback.es: Used to + verbo base cuenta un hábito pasado que ya terminó; los otros dos cambian el significado.

origin.text: De niño, cada verano ibas al lago con tus primos, pero ya no lo haces.

prompt.es: Escribe la deducción sobre el pan desaparecido.

answer.text: Someone must have eaten the bread.
accepted: Someone must have eaten the bread.
Somebody must have eaten the bread.
Someone must have eaten it.

feedback.es: La deducción sobre un hecho pasado se construye con must have + participio.

origin.text: Había pan en la mesa y ahora no está. Estás seguro de que alguien se lo comió.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué piensa el hablante sobre Tom.

choices.text: Tom is probably asleep.
Tom was late for bed.
Tom should answer his phone.

feedback.es: Must have gone to bed early es una deducción: el hablante cree que Tom probablemente duerme.

origin.audio: Tom isn't answering his phone. He must have gone to bed early.

prompt.es: Critica a un amigo que no estudió y suspendió.

choices.text: You must have studied more.
You should have studied more.
You used to study more.

feedback.es: Should have + participio reprocha lo que no se hizo; must have deduciría un hecho y used to hablaría de un hábito.

origin.text: Tu amigo no estudió nada y suspendió el examen. Le dices lo que tenía que haber hecho.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuando éramos niños, nadábamos en el lago cada verano.»

answer.text: would
accepted: would
used to

feedback.es: Would o used to cuentan un hábito repetido del pasado.

origin.text: When we were kids, we ___ swim in the lake every summer.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada condicional, deducción o deseo con lo que expresa.

pairs: If I had the money, I would buy a flat.
If I had known, I would have called.
They must have missed the bus.
You should have waited.
I hope it stops raining.

feedback.es: If + pasado simple es irreal de hoy, if + had + participio es irreal del pasado, y must have, should have y hope tienen cada uno su mensaje.

pairs: If I had the money, I would buy a flat.
If I had known, I would have called.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ha cambiado para el hablante.

choices.text: The speaker gets up later now.
The speaker wishes mornings were shorter.
The speaker enjoys mornings now.

feedback.es: Used to habla de un hábito pasado; el hablante lo contrasta con now: antes odiaba las mañanas y ahora las disfruta.

origin.audio: I used to hate getting up early, but now I love my mornings.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Debería habernos dicho la verdad.»

answer.text: She should have told us the truth

feedback.es: Should have + participio critica algo que no se hizo en el pasado.

prompt.es: Expresa que esperas que tu hermana apruebe.

choices.text: I hope she passes the exam.
I wish she passes the exam.
I hope she would have passed the exam.

feedback.es: Hope + presente expresa un deseo posible; wish + presente o hope + would have no encajan con un resultado aún desconocido.

origin.text: Tu hermana hizo hoy un examen y aún no sabes el resultado. Quieres decir que confías en que apruebe.

es: Corregir en un párrafo errores de inversión, condicional, deducción, reporte y estructuras de rumor aplicando cinco controles de revisión.

teaching.en: Never had she seen such a crowd at the station.
teaching.es: Nunca había visto tanta gente en la estación.
teaching.explanationEs: Tras never, el auxiliar va antes del sujeto: had she seen, no she had seen.
segments: Never had she seen such
a crowd at the station.
teaching.audioText: Never had she seen such a crowd at the station.

teaching.en: The mayor is said to have resigned last night.
teaching.es: Se dice que el alcalde dimitió anoche.
teaching.explanationEs: Is said to have + participio cuenta un rumor sobre algo pasado.
segments: The mayor is said to
have resigned last night.
teaching.audioText: The mayor is said to have resigned last night.

teaching.en: If I had known about the delay, I would have taken a taxi.
teaching.es: Si hubiera sabido lo del retraso, habría tomado un taxi.
teaching.explanationEs: If + had + participio; would have va solo en la otra parte de la frase.
segments: If I had known about the delay,
I would have taken a taxi.
teaching.audioText: If I had known about the delay, I would have taken a taxi.

teaching.en: She must have been exhausted after the long flight.
teaching.es: Seguro que estaba agotada después del largo vuelo.
teaching.explanationEs: Must have been + adjetivo deduce cómo estaba alguien en el pasado.
segments: She must have been exhausted
after the long flight.
teaching.audioText: She must have been exhausted after the long flight.

teaching.en: He told me that he had already booked a taxi.
teaching.es: Me dijo que ya había reservado un taxi.
teaching.explanationEs: Al reportar, el pasado retrocede un paso: had booked. Con told hace falta decir a quién (me).
segments: He told me that he
had already booked a taxi.
teaching.audioText: He told me that he had already booked a taxi.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase corrige el error de inversión?

choices.text: Hardly she sat down when the phone rang.
Hardly had sat she down when the phone rang.
Hardly had she sat down when the phone rang.

feedback.es: Tras hardly el auxiliar had va delante del sujeto: Hardly had she sat down.

hint.es: Tras hardly, el auxiliar had va antes del sujeto.

origin.text: Hardly she had sat down when the phone rang.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si hubiéramos sabido lo de la lluvia, habríamos traído paraguas.»

answer.text: had
accepted: had

feedback.es: If + had + participio es la forma del pasado irreal en la parte del if.

hint.es: En la parte del if del pasado irreal va pasado perfecto: had + participio.

origin.text: If we ___ known about the rain, we would have brought umbrellas.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Se dice que el jefe se fue a las seis.»

answer.text: The manager is said to have left at six

feedback.es: Is said to have + participio cuenta un rumor sobre algo que ya pasó.

hint.es: Empieza con el sujeto y sigue con is said to have + participio.

prompt.es: Corrige la frase con inversión.

answer.text: Never had I felt so tired after a match.
accepted: Never had I felt so tired after a match.
Never before had I felt so tired after a match.

feedback.es: Con never al inicio, el auxiliar had pasa delante del sujeto: Never had I felt.

origin.text: Never I had felt so tired after a match.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con el punto de revisión que aplica.

pairs: Never had we seen such a long queue.
The pilot is said to have left early.
If she had known, she would have come.
Sara told me that she had lost her bag.

feedback.es: Cada frase muestra un control: inversión tras never, rumor con is said to have, condicional del pasado y reporte con retroceso.

pairs: Never had we seen such a long queue.

choices.text: Mia told me that she had already booked the hotel.
Mia said me that she had already booked the hotel.
Mia told that she had already booked the hotel.

feedback.es: Con told hace falta decir a quién, y el pasado retrocede un paso: had already booked.

origin.text: Mia te dijo ayer: «Ya he reservado el hotel». Ahora se lo cuentas a otra persona.

prompt.es: Completa las dos frases del párrafo de Leo.

answer.text: than | to
accepted: than | to
than
to

feedback.es: No sooner se completa con than, y el rumor sobre un hecho pasado usa is said to have + participio.

sentences: No sooner had we arrived ___ it started to rain.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué habría pasado con más información.

choices.text: Sara knew about the traffic and left early.
Sara left late because she did not know about the traffic.
Sara will leave earlier next time.

feedback.es: If + had + participio describe el pasado irreal: Sara no sabía del tráfico y salió tarde.

prompt.es: Señala el reporte bien formado.

choices.text: My manager said us that the shop had closed.

feedback.es: Told necesita su complemento (us) y el pasado retrocede a had lost; said us y told that son incorrectos.

title.en: A song, a clip, a message
title.es: Una canción, un clip, un mensaje

es: Comprender el tema, el tono y las estructuras del nivel en fragmentos breves de canción, clip o mensaje, y dar una reacción personal con una razón.

teaching.en: The song sounds happy, but the lyrics are actually quite sad.
teaching.es: La canción suena alegre, pero la letra es en realidad bastante triste.
teaching.explanationEs: La música y la letra pueden tener tonos distintos: el mensaje está en las palabras.

lyrics are actually quite sad.
teaching.audioText: The song sounds happy, but the lyrics are actually quite sad.

teaching.en: In the chorus, the singer repeats one line: I wish I had stayed.
teaching.es: En el estribillo, la cantante repite un verso: ojalá me hubiera quedado.
teaching.explanationEs: Wish + had + participio expresa arrepentimiento; el estribillo repite la idea central.
segments: In the chorus, the singer repeats one
line: I wish I had stayed.

teaching.en: I think the message is that we should not wait for a perfect moment.

title.en: Tell a story with a twist

es: Escribir un relato con un hábito pasado, una deducción, una cláusula de participio, un arrepentimiento con wish y un giro final.

teaching.en: When I was nine, we would visit my grandmother every Sunday.
teaching.es: Cuando tenía nueve años, visitábamos a mi abuela cada domingo.
teaching.explanationEs: Would + verbo base cuenta un hábito pasado y crea el escenario del relato.
segments: When I was nine, we would
visit my grandmother every Sunday.
teaching.audioText: When I was nine, we would visit my grandmother every Sunday.

teaching.en: One evening the cake had disappeared, so the dog must have eaten it.
teaching.es: Una tarde el pastel había desaparecido, así que el perro debió de comérselo.
teaching.explanationEs: Had + participio da el hecho anterior y must have + participio, la deducción del misterio.
segments: One evening the cake had disappeared, so
the dog must have eaten it.
teaching.audioText: One evening the cake had disappeared, so the dog must have eaten it.

teaching.en: Walking into the kitchen, I noticed a strange smell.

teaching.en: I wish I had locked the door that night.
